field.label: Enable DNS filtering
field.help: Block lookups through Unbound for the categories and domains below. Clients must use this firewall for DNS.

field.label: Block categories (all clients)
field.help: Applies to every client. Per-group categories are set in each policy. Lists come from the feed below plus a small built-in seed list.

field.label: Always block domains
field.help: Domains (and their subdomains) blocked for everyone.

field.label: Always allow domains
field.help: These domains are never blocked by category lists.

field.label: Feed URL
field.help: Base URL that serves one text file per category (ads.txt, malware.txt, ...). Example: http://192.168.1.73:8080/feeds. Leave empty to use only the seed lists.
